verdict.rationale: Cline's first-party docs describe a CLI headless mode for scripts and CI/CD, with processable output. Concrete invocations are shown, including an auto-approve flag, piped stdin, and use inside GitHub Actions and GitLab pipelines. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of headless scripting, and detailed documentation of the output format and exit codes.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run the agent non-interactively in scripts for workflow automation

citations.quote: Run Cline in your terminal with interactive chat or fully headless automation for CI/CD and scripting.
Use headless mode for scripts/automation and processable output.
cline --auto-approve true "run tests and fix failures"
Run it headlessly inside GitHub Actions, GitLab, or any pipeline.
